review_type: Model-assisted complete delivered-source reading and audience curation. Not human scholarly review, language certification or live-source verification.
method: Two model reviewers read numeric source-record positions 1–50 and 51–100 respectively, including every stored question, full answer and all notes. One truncated initial display was re-read in smaller complete displays before recording completion. Each English curation reason was checked against its full source content.
verdict: Full-read subtask COMPLETE. N10 beginner-readiness and visible routing remain OPEN. The 100 full sources form a mixed Arabic reference collection, not 100 uniformly beginner-ready lessons.
gate_implication: No audience-fit objection to retaining the full attributed mixed reference corpus. Do not claim universal beginner readiness or make all records default self-learning cards. Apply reader-level routing in G4-B, preserving source text.
